title: Visible Measures along $Ω(n)$ and Distribution of Horocycle Orbits
summary: Let $Ω(n)$ denote the number of prime factors of $n$, counted with multiplicities. We study the set $Acc^Ω(x)$ of weak-$^*$ limits of the sequence $\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n\leq N}δ_{T^{Ω(n)}x}$ in $σ$-compact dynamical systems $ (X,T)$, demonstrating that if $x \in X$ is quasi-generic for an ergodic measure $μ$, then $μ\in Acc^Ω(x)$. This extends a result of Bergelson and Richter, who studied the problem in the setting of uniquely ergodic systems.
